from collections import defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); H=W=23
# nearest-nonzero fill per row
def f(g):
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(H):
        row=g[r]; nzs=[(c,v) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v: continue
            # candidates: expand outward from c; nearest nonzero
            best=None;bb=0
            while True:
                c1=max(0,c-bb); c2=min(W-1,c+bb)
                if c1 in nzs and c1==c2: break
                c1=max(0,c-bb); c2=min(W-1,c+bb)
                nz=[x for x in [(c1,row[c1]),(c2,row[c2])] if x[1]]
                if not nz: bb+=1; continue
                d1=abs(c-c1); d2=abs(c-c2)
                best=min(nz,key=lambda t:(min(d1,d2),t[0]))
                break
            out[r][c]=best[1]
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(name, f(G[name+' input'])==G[name+' output'])
